artDirection: Whimsical high fashion: McQueen natural history and Escher interlocking geometry. Midnight navy, warm ivory, muted rose.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production textile repeat tile for the Finfolk website animal theme, square 1024x1024.
Input image 1 is a reference for the Finfolk Nasties animal family and tessellated composition, not an image to reproduce. Develop this into an original, sophisticated, whimsical couture print: Alexander McQueen's natural-history theatricality meets Escher's rhythmic interlocking geometry. Distinctive quirky animal silhouettes, artful anatomical details, finely engraved contours, elegant graphic negative space. Grown-up fashion scarf / jacquard design, charmingly strange but never childish. Crisp flat ink artwork with very subtle etched texture, no gradients, no 3D or fabric folds. Limit to midnight navy #172440 and warm ivory #eee5d3 with tiny restrained muted rose #99596a accents. Balanced multi-directional all-over composition, 5 to 9 medium sized recognisable creatures, interlocking silhouettes and tessellated negative spaces; no huge central hero. Truly seamless repeat on both axes: elements cropped at an edge continue at the opposite edge without a seam. Fill entire square, no margins, frame, labels, lettering, logos, FF monograms, mockups or watermark. No sailor stripes, no cute smiling emoji faces, no generic floral filler.
Subject: BLUE-RINGED OCTOPUS ONLY. Sculptural bulbous mantles and eight curling arms form clever interlocking arabesques. Distinctive tiny circular ring markings become precise ornamental inlays. Curious small ink eyes, expressive posture without cartoon smiles. Alternate ivory octopuses on navy with navy octopuses nested in ivory negative spaces. Refined, mysterious, witty. Output a single finished square repeat tile.
